narrative.overview: The interface behaves like a family's handwritten gift list pinned up in the parlour for the season: warm cream paper, pine-green bunting, terracotta-red ribbon used sparingly, and antique gold reserved for keepsake moments (stars, garland lights, the tree topper). Nothing is glossy or app-shop generic — ornament is hand-crafted signal, not decoration noise. The system is phone-first by construction: layouts are single-column at 320 px, all interactive targets are at least 44–48 px, and desktop is treated as the organically-grown wide version of the same sheet, never a separate design. The palette follows the confirmed mood: pine green leads, holly-red accents sparingly, antique gold only for keepsake moments, all on warm cream paper. Components feel tactile and restrained: gentle lift on hover, dashed edges to signal empty or physical states, italic serif reserved for personal, human notes.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream paper ground with a single soft radial light in the top-right corner
Pine-green chrome (header, explainer banner) with cream-ivory text (#fff8e8) and gold icons
Holly-red as the one action accent — buttons, wish numbers, star pin, eyebrow labels
Georgia serif for anything spoken about a person; Arial for anything the person uses
Hand-made signals: taped wish card, ribbon-framed portrait medallions, dashed empty states, folded print cards
44–48 px touch targets everywhere; 16 px inputs on phones to prevent iOS zoom

rules.name: The One Red Voice Rule
rules.body: Holly-red is the only action color. If two elements on one screen both scream in red, one of them is wrong; gold and green never carry calls to action.

rules.name: The Keepsake Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only where the system remembers, not where it asks: stars, ornament lights, framing accents, the tree topper. No gold buttons.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Black Rule
rules.body: Text, lines and shadows are green- or brown-tinted. Pure #000 does not exist in this palette; #fffefa is the whitest white.

rules.name: The Spoken-vs-Used Rule
rules.body: Serif for what is said about a person (names, headlines, personal notes); sans for what the person operates (buttons, labels, inputs, help). A serif button label is a bug.

rules.name: The Italic-is-Human Rule
rules.body: Georgia italic marks a human voice: the em-accent in the hero, wish-card titles, the closing "Com carinho" note. Never for emphasis in UI copy.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat; a shadow appears only for hover/lift or to make the hero's paper cutout look cut out. No stacked, diffuse shadow layers.

rules.name: The Tonal-Layering Rule
rules.body: When something must separate, move one step paper → surface → parchment/sage tint before adding shadow or border weight.

dos: Do keep every interactive target ≥ 44 px (buttons 48 px) at 320 px width, and inputs at 16 px font on phones.
Do use holly-red for exactly one action per screen; keep gold for ornament and keepsake moments only.
Do separate surfaces with the tonal ladder (paper → surface → parchment/sage tint) and 1 px #e5ddcc borders before reaching for shadows.
Do alternate the 3 px ribbon top-border by its context rule (green/rust members, gold forms).
Do use dashed 1 px borders to mean "empty or physical" — empty states and fold guides, nothing else.
Do use Georgia italic for the human voice (notes, card titles) and keep all UI controls in Arial.
Do keep ornament inline-SVG, local, aria-hidden, and flat-illustrated; preserve prefers-reduced-motion compliance and the skip-link/focus-outline baseline.
Do print via the same cqw-based card internals so screen preview equals paper output.
donts: Don't introduce blue/purple/teal as interface colors, gradients on text/buttons, or glassmorphism — the world is pine/cream/gold flat paper.
Don't use webfonts, icon fonts, or CDN assets; only locally-served system stacks and inline SVG.
Don't use emoji as interface icons (they may appear only inside member-written wish text).
Don't add pure black text or pure white backgrounds; use #263f34 on #faf6ed/#fffdf7.
Don't make anything pill-shaped except avatars, the member-count badge and the light bulbs; the radius ceiling is 14 px.
Don't shadow-stack: one ambient shadow per surface, max.
Don't put English in family-facing UI, or Portuguese in code/routes/dev output (AGENTS.md language rule).
Don't replace factual profile content or printed card data with marketing claims; the QR always resolves to /p/<stable-id>.
